findings.fresh_tail21_23: Two clean public API runs favor Toeplitz by about2-3%; seed838383 had a noisy interval reversing some points. Candidate for replication, not a universal crossover proof.
findings.exact_tail24: Close to tied and direction/run dependent; retain exact matrix24 to avoid unsupported small-gain claims.
findings.already_prepared_tail21_23: Fullbatch+tail85..87 benefit did not persist in reversed-order run; no separate cutoff change established.
findings.n_le20: Matrix remains clearly faster than padded64 Toeplitz.
findings.n_ge25: Toeplitz clearly faster than rounded matrix for both directions.

recommendation: For root review/replication: allow fresh standalone tails21..23 to use Toeplitz, keep exact24 matrix and keep already-prepared tail cutoff24. No production edit made.
limitations: One VM/host class for crossover study.
VM frequency or host contention caused transient intervals with up to~10% ratio reversals; raw samples retained.
